propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is not consulted on a healthy pass, but the blast radius of the oracle narrowed and would not catch regressions where moved operations unconditionally stamp updated_at.

The moved binding lifecycle operations (clear_absent and siblings) are structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window idempotency fixture pass, so mutation seeding cannot drive the integration test red.
The no-stamp contract for clear_absent is already pinned at unit tier via test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence.
